label: Raptorial Mantis
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One independent square transparent Glaze pure-art asset. EMULSION ROOKERY, physical wildlife sculptures made entirely from continuous perforated PHOTOGRAPHIC CELLULOID FILM STRIPS. Our own ibis reference supplies only the material, palette and restrained macro lighting; create a wholly different subject. Thin springy translucent strips with clearly visible RECTANGULAR EMULSION FRAME WINDOWS and paired regular rows of small SQUARE SPROCKET HOLES along every major strip edge. Petrol-blue, teal, soft coral and copper dye transparencies, subtle photographic grain inside each window, thin amber-clear edges with restrained glossy reflections. Frame windows contain abstract dye gradients only, no pictures/writing/codes. Strips bend in crisp long loops, overlapping plates and pleats to CONSTRUCT the entire body; no ordinary skin or solid toy decorated with a film pattern. Genuine alpha through gaps and perforations. No fabric/feathers, fuzzy fibres, paper quilling, metal, glass, wet cellulose, smooth plastic toys, cinema equipment or standalone reels. Whole subject and all projecting extremities inside central70%, ample transparent space on all sides. No floor, exterior cast shadow, haze, opaque backing panel, border, collage, lettering, numbers, film edge codes, logos, dates, clock/battery/calendar pictures or UI. Readable singular silhouette at85px. SUBJECT: one complete elegant PRAYING MANTIS in upright three-quarter side pose facing right. Small triangular head with two tiny dark eyes, two long fine curved antennae, long slender neck/thorax and tapered abdomen. TWO distinct folded raptorial forearms held up in a recognisable praying pose, FOUR separately visible slender walking legs planted below with articulated bends and complete fine feet. Folded narrow film-ribbon wings run along its back. Every anatomical part constructed from curled and folded photographic film strips, rectangular frame windows and clear square sprocket-hole rows. No body skin, no insect fuzz, not a stick figure; preserve all six limbs and both antennae inside generous margins.
processing: Whole original uniformly contained within900px on transparent1024square. Alpha preserved, no subject crop/recolour/artistic edits.
